description: This Java class 'DeviceProfileImportService' handles importing, preparing, saving, and updating DeviceProfile entities within the Thingsboard platform, including setting ownership, copying data, and logging actions.

classes.name: DeviceProfileImportService
classes.description: A service class for importing DeviceProfile entities, extending BaseEntityImportService with specific logic for device profiles.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Assigns the tenant ID to the device profile.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device profile by setting internal IDs for related entities.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the device profile, updating external IDs if necessary.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Logs the action of saving or updating the device profile.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the device profile.

methods.name: cleanupForComparison
methods.description: Cleans up the device profile for comparison purposes.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DEVICE_PROFILE.
